# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 22 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 22 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_022_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 22

**22:1** Herod was now searching for John. He sent officers to Zechariah while he was at the altar, saying: "Where have you hidden your son?" Zechariah answered: "I am a minister of God and serve at his temple. I do not know where my son is."

**22:2** The officers returned and reported everything to Herod. Herod was furious and said: "His son is destined to become king of Israel." He sent the officers back again with a message: "Tell the truth — where is your son? You should know that your life is in my hands." The officers went and delivered the message.

**22:3** Zechariah replied: "I am a witness for God. Take my blood if you will. But the Lord will receive my spirit, for you are about to shed innocent blood at the entrance of the temple of the Lord."

**22:4** And at the first light of dawn, Zechariah was murdered. The children of Israel did not know that he had been killed.
